extDescription.message: Capture pages as editable Design Editor design nodes and extract a design.md design-system guide in one click.

statusDesignWorking.message: Collecting de-identified page style evidence and asking Design Editor AI…

statusDesignSmartSuccess.message: Generated and downloaded design.md with the configured AI.

statusDesignFallbackSuccess.message: AI unavailable; generated and downloaded design.md with the deterministic local fallback: $1

designFallbackPairing.message: Design Editor has not authorized this extension for AI generation; the local fallback was used.

designFallbackUnsupported.message: This Design Editor version does not support smart design.md generation.

designBusy.message: Another capture or design.md action is already running.

designEvidenceTruncated.message: Sampled $1 visible elements; the collector stopped at its safety limit.

designFallbackModel.message: No usable AI model is configured.

pickHint.message: Click an element to capture it

endpointHint.message: Desktop app: Settings → MCP → start the server (default port 3100).

statusTruncated.message: Note: the page hit the extractor's 40,000-node cap, so the capture is partial.

errorRestrictedTab.message: Chrome does not allow extensions to run on this page. Open a normal http(s) page and try again.

errorInjection.message: Could not run the capture script in this tab: $1

errorNoSnapshot.message: The extractor produced no snapshot (the page may have no visible body).

errorChunkLost.message: The captured snapshot was lost mid-transfer (the page probably navigated). Try again.

errorEndpoint.message: Endpoint must be loopback with a port — 127.0.0.1:3100 or localhost:3100.

errorOffline.message: Design Editor is not reachable at $1. Launch the desktop app and start Settings → MCP → server, or run: design-editor --serve-web 3100

errorTimeout.message: Design Editor at $1 accepted the connection but did not answer within $2s. It may be busy or stuck — check the app, then try again.

errorNoIngress.message: This Design Editor build has no extension ingress ($1). Update the app, or use Download .de and open the file in Design Editor.

errorTooLarge.message: This capture is larger than $1 MB, which Design Editor's snapshot route refuses. Use Download .de, then open the file in Design Editor.

errorCoreMissing.message: This extension has not been built. Run packages/de-chrome-extension/scripts/build-wasm.sh, then hit Reload on the extension card. ($1)

errorCoreInit.message: The extension is built, but its logic core would not start. Re-run packages/de-chrome-extension/scripts/build-wasm.sh and hit Reload on the extension card. ($1)

errorPickUnavailable.message: Element capture is unavailable: the extension's background worker is not running. Check the extension card in chrome://extensions for an error, re-run build-wasm.sh, then hit Reload. ($1)
